news.title: Holiday Extras 分享 Codex 支持应用重建的实践
news.body: 案例介绍用 Codex 将客户服务经验转化为应用改进，并报告预订转化和开发时间变化。数据为企业特定项目自报，不能外推为普遍收益。
news.title_original: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
news.body_original: With Codex, Holiday Extras is turning customer expertise into better apps, higher booking conversion and new possibilities for growth.

news.title: MIT 研究减少气候模拟器训练的数据需求
news.body: 方法旨在以较少训练数据改善快速气候模拟器的性能和适应性，支持多情景分析。预测可靠性仍需按区域、干预方式及训练覆盖检验。
news.title_original: New research could lead to faster, trustworthy AI models for climate prediction
news.body_original: MIT scientists developed a training method to generate models that simulate the effects of human activities on climate much more quickly than other approaches.

news.title: OpenAI 支持 AI 与儿童安全研究
news.body: 公告讨论建设儿童安全和发展相关证据，支持适龄保护、家长工具及风险评估等方向。研究与政策倡议的落实仍需后续跟踪。
news.title_original: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
news.body_original: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.

news.title: Gilbert + Tobin 讨论 AI 对律所业务的影响
news.body: Sam Nickless 访谈回顾从试验到个人及组织生产力的应用历程，并讨论领导支持和采用文化。观点和案例指标来自企业经验。
news.title_original: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
news.body_original: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

news.title: Google 探索可穿戴信号辅助 CKM 风险画像
news.body: 研究性框架将被动传感信号转化为可干预健康指标，并模拟十二周习惯变化情景，扩展结合血液标志物。模型情景输出与实际临床效果需分别验证。
news.title_original: Using wearables to enable cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) risk profiling for personalized coaching

news.title: OpenAI 回顾面向退役军人的 Plus 支持计划
news.body: 公告介绍符合条件的过渡期军人与退役军人领取一年免费访问及参加培训的情况，并分享求职使用案例。资格和申领条款需按计划要求确认。
news.title_original: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
news.body_original: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus. See how they use it to prepare for civilian careers.

news.title: BotPsy 探索小于十亿参数的端侧智能体
news.body: 模型基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B，面向函数调用与个人助理工作流。专用任务表现和端侧可用性仍取决于测试、硬件及部署设置。
news.title_original: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model

news.title: JioStar 分享大规模内容发现中的 AI 架构经验
news.body: 首席架构师访谈讨论产品落地、技术权衡及生产评估，并回顾小团队开发过程。经验受平台规模和业务环境影响。
news.title_original: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
news.body_original: JioStar’s Vijay Seshadri explains AI discovery at 500M-user scale. Read his lessons on evals, guardrails, and taking AI into production.

news.title: 池化感知训练压缩多向量检索表示
news.body: 文章让编码器在训练时适应词元向量合并，以改善相同存储预算下的检索质量。报告的压缩与保留率来自特定模型和 NanoBEIR 评估。
news.title_original: Token Pooling-Aware Training for Multi-Vector Embedding Models

news.title: OpenAI 推出照护者日常 AI 使用培训
news.body: 工作坊介绍照护日程、资源检索和通俗资料整理等用途，并强调隐私及专业咨询边界。公告描述支持计划，实际帮助效果需随实施评估。
news.title_original: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
news.body_original: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

news.title: ChatGPT 推出企业资料与商业智能体测试版
news.body: Business Hub 支持符合条件的企业认领和维护资料、查看互动信息。Business Agents 初期面向美国部分电商与在线服务企业，资格和可用范围需逐项确认。
news.body_original: Manage your business information, get insights about how your business shows up, and turn interest into action in ChatGPT.

news.title: 教育合作报告讨论如何补齐 AI 使用指导
news.body: 文章总结欧洲、中东和非洲教育合作中的教师准备、AI 素养及地方支持经验。调查与国家案例有各自范围，不能直接推断普遍学习收益。
news.title_original: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
news.body_original: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

news.title: 新加坡航空分享 AI 客服与员工工具实践
news.body: 案例介绍客服机器人、旅行发现和内部平台的应用，并报告满意度及处理时间变化。指标来自企业案例，实际效果依赖使用场景。
news.title_original: Singapore Airlines elevates travel & work with OpenAI technology
news.body_original: Discover how Singapore Airlines uses OpenAI models and API to enhance customer support, travel discovery, and employee productivity, doubling CSAT for its Kris chatbot.

news.title: OpenAI 与 Upwork 研究自由职业需求变化
news.body: 研究讨论平台需求、技能组合及 AI 相关项目预算的变化。平台观察有样本和时间范围，不能直接外推为整个劳动力市场的因果结论。
news.title_original: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
news.body_original: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

news.title: MIT 团队获资助研发新一代除草方案
news.body: ARPA-H 项目支持团队探索兼顾农业需求与健康保护的除草替代方案。报道描述研发目标与资金安排，产品效果及安全性仍需后续验证。
news.title_original: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers
news.body_original: With up to $53 million from ARPA-H, the researchers will use AI to generate safer herbicides that reduce dependence on imports and improve the security of the U.S. food supply.
